author: Ethan Brooks
title: Invest in Courageous, Progressive Journalism
text:
WASHINGTON — The fight for democracy continues, with Senate Republicans reportedly aiming to block even popular Democratic initiatives under the Biden administration.
The political landscape in the second half of 2023 is marked by challenges to democracy, including rising prices and threats to individual rights.
The nation faces persistent struggles for democracy. Senate Republicans are reportedly working to obstruct Democratic measures. Economic pressures and threats to rights are significant concerns. Public engagement and financial support are vital for independent journalism. As the year unfolds, the nation grapples with lies, corruption, and violence, fueling a continuous battle for America’s future. This includes concerted efforts by Senate Republicans to impede legislative progress, even on widely supported proposals championed by President Biden.
Americans are reportedly fighting for representation and resisting the perceived rise of fascism amidst soaring prices and jeopardized rights. Despite the prevailing difficulties within the journalism industry, a loyal readership has allowed for navigation of the current landscape.
Gratitude is extended to readers, donors, and subscribers for their unwavering commitment. While readership alone is deeply appreciated, contributions are crucial for the sustainability of independent news. The goal is to maintain editorial integrity during critical times.
A monthly donation of $10 or more, or a one-time contribution of $95 or more, offers ad-free access to original reporting and exclusive investigative content.
For those who wish to contribute, donations can be made online. A one-time donation option is also available.
Donations can also be sent via check to Raw Story Media, Inc., P.O. Box 38654, Germantown, TN 38183.
Support is directed towards original investigative reporting and the RawStory+ Membership Program. Contributions are not tax-deductible.
